title: Cow holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 40 Q46 30 52 20' stroke='#c8d8ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='16' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#e94f64'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='12' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff9aa8'/>
  <polygon points='52,27 54,27 53,30' fill='#b8324a'/>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='66' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <!-- patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6b5b95'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#6b5b95'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='76' width='5' height='13' rx='2' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <rect x='42' y='78' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <rect x='54' y='78' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <rect x='63' y='76' width='5' height='13' rx='2' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='86' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#3c3560'/>
  <rect x='42' y='87' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#3c3560'/>
  <rect x='54' y='87' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#3c3560'/>
  <rect x='63' y='86' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#3c3560'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding balloon -->
  <path d='M64 58 Q72 48 56 40' stroke='#f5f0ea' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f5f0ea'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='44' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6b5b95'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8b8c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8b8c0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='55' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#f7c6cf'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='54' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#b8607a'/>
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='54' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#b8607a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#2e2650'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#2e2650'/>
  <circle cx='26.7' cy='45.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='35.7' cy='45.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='37' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#f0d9a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='37' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#f0d9a8'/>
</svg>
